section.p: Consider a "Create User API" chapter in an "Application API Reference Guide" document where you want to document an API operation, its syntax, parameters, request payload, and runtime configuration values. Instead of using generic paragraphs and tables, use API-specific DITA elements to provide semantic markup for API names, parameters, variables, and parameter definitions.
section.codeblock:
Create User API Creates a new user account in the application.
API Name

The CreateUser API creates a user record and assigns the specified role.

Syntax

CreateUser( username, email, role )

Parameters username Unique user name for the account. email Email address associated with the account. role Application role assigned to the user.
Request Example { "username": "jdoe", "email": "jdoe@example.com", "role": "administrator" }
